citations.text:
Worked as a plasterer. Lived at 1035 Redwood Avenue.

Given as residing at 59 Redwood Avenue at the time of his death.

On September 28, at age 35, he led police on a high speed chase where he travelled at "reckless" speeds, went through stop signs, drove on the boulevard, and rammed a police cruiser. Police fired two shots at him.

John stated "I was afraid of gangsters. I was at 552 Dufferin Avenue and had been hit on the head with a beer bottle." He was also found with a stolen child's tricycle in the car worth $24. He replied "I don't know how it got there." He pleaded guilty to driving an automobile in a criminally negligent manner.

John was fined $200 and costs, and was prohibited from driving anywhere in Canada for 1 year on "Thursday". He was also placed on 2 years suspended sentence for stealing the tricycle. (source: Winnipeg Free Press, October 7, 1955)

October 6, 1955: Criminal Negligence, 1 count, $200 fine, I/D 4 months.

October 6, 1955: Theft, 1 count, 2 years suspended sentence.

November 4, 1957: PWDPP, 1 count, $50 fine, I/D 2 months.

October 22, 1964: Trafficking, 1 count under Food and Drug Act, 6 months sentence, 2 additional charges of trafficking on the same date disposed, concurrent on each.

April 4, 1968: Theft, 1 count, $25 fine and I/D 14 days.

Obituary appeared in the Winnipeg Free Press on January 25, 1980.

"Age 59 years".

"Born and educated in Riverton", worked self-employed in the plastering business for the past 30 years.

Prayers were held at 7:00 pm, January 27, 1980 at Cropo Funeral Chapel. Funeral service was held at 10:00 am from the chapel, with Rev. M. Zaleschuk officiating.
